codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex identified 6 issues: (1) Quality Standards / Quality Standards Enforcement sections are procedural checklists, not verbose fluff — false positives in draft; (2) '## Workflow Overview' is a prefix match of '## Overview' but the detection rule targets exact '## Overview' — over-broad pattern match; (3) clean.md Safety Features contains substantive safety behavior (checkpointing, approval, reference detection) — partial false positive; (4) dev.md undercounted — Agent Development Use Cases (133 lines), Example End-to-End Workflow (42 lines), Success Metrics (15 lines), JSON Storage Policy (19 lines), Integration with /clean (11 lines) are verbose tutorial content not counted in draft's 23-line estimate; (5) dev-command.md similarly undercounted with same pattern; (6) severity threshold wording was internally inconsistent ('minor OR <15%' conflicts with 'below 50 = advisory only'). One observation: changed-files conclusion correct, no .md files missed.
